pin_title: 6 Entryway & Hallway Organisation Buys UK Homes Swear By
pin_hook: Tidy hallways start here - all highly rated
pin_description: Entryway and hallway organisation buys UK homes love: a shoe storage bench, wall coat hooks, a wooden key holder, and woven baskets for shelves and shoes. Easy hallway tidy ideas and home organisation inspiration. #ad #hallwaystorage #homeorganisation #entrywaydecor #ukhomes
intro: If your hallway is where coats, shoes and keys go to pile up, these highly rated buys make it easy to keep everything in its place.

products.name: VASAGLE Shoe Storage Bench with Cushion
products.headline: Sit, store shoes and tidy up in one go
products.why: A padded bench that hides shoes underneath, perfect for small hallways where space is tight.

products.name: VonHaus Wall Mounted Coat Hooks with Storage Baskets
products.headline: Coats on hooks, clutter in baskets
products.why: Five hooks plus two baskets underneath give coats, bags and gloves a proper home by the door.

products.name: SWTYMIKI Wall Key Holder with Wood Tray
products.headline: Never hunt for your keys again
products.why: Six hooks and a little tray for post keep keys, mail and odds and ends off the counter.
products.photo_query: wall key holder wood hooks entryway

products.name: VonHaus Seagrass Storage Baskets, Set of 4
products.headline: Smarten up open shelves instantly
products.why: Handwoven seagrass baskets that look good on open shelving while hiding scarves, gloves and general hallway clutter.

products.name: La Jolíe Muse Woven Storage Baskets, Set of 4
products.headline: Four sizes for every odd bit and bob
products.why: A nesting set that works just as well for shoes by the door as it does for makeup or stationery elsewhere in the house.

products.name: LA JOLIE MUSE Small Cotton Woven Storage Baskets, 3 Pack
products.headline: Corral small items without the mess
products.why: Neat little baskets that are ideal for sunglasses, dog leads and other entryway odds and ends.
